verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents running AI-driven browser agents in managed cloud sessions, started with a single API call, with built-in Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and BrowserUse agents and no infrastructure for the user to manage. That covers submitting a natural-language browser task over a hosted API without running a browser yourself. How results come back is not evidenced: the pack never mentions polling a task-status endpoint or webhook callbacks, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. Missing for 10: documented polling/task-status retrieval, webhook delivery of results, published API spec, independent hands-on corroboration of the agent task API.
